12. (a)   Consider the following recursive function:
recfn(N)
    if N <= 0
        then
            return 0
        else
            if N mod 2 = 0
                then
                    return recfn(N-1) - N
                else
                    return recfn(N-1) + N
            endif
    endif
end recfn
Determine the value of variable X after execution of the following program statement:
X = recfn(5)

Describe one difference between interrupt-driven input and polling in a control system

markscheme.marking_summary: With interrupts, the device signals when it needs attention; with polling, the processor repeatedly checks device status even when no event has occurred.
source_issues: Original MS treats polling as having no priority and interrupts as hardware-only; these are not universal and not repeated.
